checkpoint_selection: fixed final checkpoint; no performance-based search

candidate.weight_format: expert NVFP4 E2M1 / E4M3 block16 / FP32 global scale
candidate.expert_lora: merge once in an isolated inference copy before quantization
candidate.nonexpert_lora_and_action_embeddings: preserve the validated original execution path
candidate.graphs: prefix language model and decoder; prefix KV copy once per observation

evaluation.reference_runs: reuse the existing controller's completed and audited final BF16 evaluation
evaluation.scope: Known Spatial tasks and reused development initial states; not an unseen test
evaluation.selection_text_erratum: The frozen confidence protocol retains an obsolete ten-candidate selection sentence. The controlling finalonly schedule fixes step100000; preserve original evidence and report this metadata clarification.

additional_transfer.controller: fixed geometric IK bridge; separately validated scripted feasibility

required_evidence: Final checkpoint/base/config SHA verification and original-file preservation
Export reload, eager repeat and eager-versus-graph action/probability/confidence checks
BF16-versus-candidate action MAE/max, gripper agreement and probability differences
500 paired LIBERO episodes per arm, artifact/trace audit, recovered/lost counts and paired intervals
Raw confidence/failure association, with undefined AUROC retained for single-class results
Exclusive RTX5090 whole-policy p50/p95, memory and separate warmup/capture costs
Document and review actual results, including regressions; no automatic equivalence claim

publication.timing: one combined commit/push after final evidence, documentation and review
publication.release: experimental adapter only: four shards, index, config, model card and SHA manifest
publication.candidate_regression: Preserve and disclose results; do not describe a regressed or inconclusive candidate as quality-equivalent.

execution.deployment: follow-up contract; no new recurring automation or unattended publication job created
